checks.claim: A yellow light warns drivers that the signal is about to turn red.
checks.why: MUTCD 4D: a yellow follows every green; its function is to warn traffic of an impending change in right-of-way.

checks.claim: An all-red interval holds every signal red for a moment to clear the intersection.
checks.why: An optional red clearance interval after the yellow lets vehicles that entered on yellow clear before conflicting traffic gets green.

sources.title: All Traffic Lights Red at Once

checks.claim: An inductive loop cut into the road feels the metal of a car above it.
checks.why: The metal of the vehicle disturbs the loop magnetic field, changing its inductance, which the detector senses.

checks.claim: Emergency vehicle preemption turns a traffic signal green for an approaching fire truck.
checks.why: Preemption receivers on the signal detect an approaching emergency vehicle and switch the signal so it gets green and others red.

sources.title: Giving emergency vehicles the green light (Winnipeg)
